note: Synthetic lending policy for the SYNAPSE demo; not any real bank's policy.

passages.title: Personal loan eligibility
passages.text: Personal loans are available to resident individuals aged 21 to 60 with a verified PAN. Minimum net monthly income is INR 25,000 for salaried applicants and INR 40,000 for self-employed applicants, with at least one year in the current job or business.

passages.title: Credit bureau score bands
passages.text: Applications with a bureau score below 650 are declined. Scores from 650 to 720 are referred to a credit officer for manual review. Scores above 720 qualify for straight-through approval when every other check passes.

passages.title: Fixed obligations to income ratio
passages.text: Existing monthly EMIs, before the new loan, must not exceed 50% of net monthly income. Applications above this limit are referred for manual review rather than declined outright.

passages.title: KYC requirements
passages.text: PAN and name must match the KYC registry. If KYC verification fails, the application is declined and the customer is asked to update KYC at a branch; no credit assessment is shared.

passages.title: Loan amount and tenure
passages.text: The loan amount may not exceed 20 times net monthly income, up to INR 25,00,000. Tenure ranges from 12 to 60 months.

passages.title: Bank statement review
passages.text: Six months of statements are reviewed for regular income credits and EMI debits. Two or more bounced payments in six months are flagged in the risk summary.

passages.title: Employment categories
passages.text: Salaried, self-employed and contract workers are eligible. Contract workers need a contract with at least six months remaining.

passages.title: Customer communication
passages.text: Pre-screening outcomes are sent by SMS within one business day. Messages state the outcome (approve, refer or decline) and never include the bureau score or the reasons for a decline.

passages.title: Pricing bands
passages.text: Interest rates are set by segment: salaried prime 10.5% to 12%, salaried mass 12% to 15%, self-employed 13% to 16%, contract 15% to 18%.

passages.title: Fraud and identity checks
passages.text: Mismatched names, recently issued PANs, or declared income that does not match statement credits are escalated to the fraud team before any decision.
